title: CRM Targeting & Reporting Analyst
text: CRM Targeting & Reporting Analyst at Officeworks Ltd (Melbourne, Bayside & South Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). About the role We are currently looking for an experienced CRM Analyst to support the development of effective campaign targeting for all campaigns and initiatives such as trading plan activities, lifecycle and journey campaigns, catalogue distributions and weekly eDM activity. Reporting to the CRM Targeting and Reporting Lead, this role will also see you responsible for the timely development and relevant reporting of insights to educate the wider marketing team on the program and campaign performance. About you Your passion for data and extensive experience mining and interpreting large data sets to produce actionable insights coupled with your ability to communicate your findings to varied audiences will see you succeed in this role. Previous experience in campaign planning and Expertise in delivering timely customer list extractions as part of campaign management process will also be a vital component of this role. Your ability to conduct post campaign analysis and leverage the insights to guide future campaign planning and targeting strategy as well as the ability to provide feedback and recommendations on an ongoing basis will improve the quality and integrity of our data and campaign process. The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience: 3+ years' experience with CRM campaign measurement and reporting within a retail or similar environment Experience in modelling, regression analysis, correlation analysis and other statistical analysis techniques Strong aptitude with simplifying the complex, turning numbers into insights Strong technical skills in querying, manipulating and merging large customer and transactional data sets (e.g. SQL, Base SAS and/or SAS Enterprise Guide, Tableau) Why us A career at Officeworks is real, possible and exciting with the following on offer: Team member discounts across the Wesfarmers group Ongoing professional development including recognised management qualifications The opportunity to work within a fast paced, growing, innovative and inspiring Australian brand When you join Officeworks you will become part of a team who are making bigger things happen…We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse, inclusive and flexible workforce. We welcome enquiries and applications from everyone in the communities which we serve.
